cd w
logos run .
stdout '^parity ok$'
logos eject -o out
cd out
go run .
stdout '^parity ok$'
# SPEC 0.3: ejected output builds with upstream go1.27.2 from $UPROOT1272.
exists $UPROOT1272/bin/go
exec $UPROOT1272/bin/go version
stdout '^go version go1\.27\.2 '
exec env -u GOROOT $UPROOT1272/bin/go build ./...
exec env -u GOROOT $UPROOT1272/bin/go run .
stdout '^parity ok$'
cd ..

-- w/go.mod --
module example.com/fback

go 1.27

require example.com/foreign v0.0.0

replace example.com/foreign => ./foreign

-- w/foreign/go.mod --
module example.com/foreign

go 1.27

-- w/foreign/f.go --
package f

import "strconv"

type N int64

func (n *N) MarshalJSON() ([]byte, error) {
	return []byte(strconv.Quote("ptr:" + strconv.FormatInt(int64(*n), 10))), nil
}

func (n N) MarshalText() ([]byte, error) {
	return []byte("val:" + strconv.FormatInt(int64(n), 10)), nil
}

type hidden struct {
	X N
}

type Public struct {
	hidden
}

type Count struct {
	N int
}

func (c *Count) IsZero() bool {
	c.N = 99
	return false
}

type Box struct {
	X Count `json:"x,omitzero"`
}

type Inner struct {
	C Count `json:"c,omitzero"`
}

type Nest struct {
	I Inner   `json:"i"`
	A [1]Box `json:"a"`
}

type Embed struct {
	*Box
}

type Mirror struct {
	P  *Box           `json:"p"`
	S  []Box          `json:"s"`
	A  *[2]Box        `json:"a"`
	M  map[string]Box `json:"m"`
	N  Nest           `json:"n"`
	V  Box            `json:"v"`
	E  Embed          `json:"e"`
	NP *Nest          `json:"np"`
	NS []Nest         `json:"ns"`
}

-- w/main.lgo --
package main

import (
	"encoding/json"
	"fmt"
	"os"
	"strings"

	"example.com/foreign"
)

type Root struct {
	P *f.Public           `json:"p"`
	S []f.Public          `json:"s"`
	A *[2]f.Public        `json:"a"`
	M map[string]f.Public `json:"m"`
}

func freshPublic(n int64) f.Public {
	var p f.Public
	p.X = f.N(n)
	return p
}

func buildInputs() (*f.Public, []f.Public, *[2]f.Public, map[string]f.Public) {
	p := freshPublic(7)
	s := []f.Public{freshPublic(1), freshPublic(2)}
	a := [2]f.Public{freshPublic(3), freshPublic(4)}
	vals := map[string]f.Public{"k": freshPublic(5)}
	return &p, s, &a, vals
}

func targetRoot() Root {
	p, s, a, vals := buildInputs()
	return Root{P: p, S: s, A: a, M: vals}
}

func mirrorRoot() any {
	p, s, a, vals := buildInputs()
	return struct {
		P *f.Public           `json:"p"`
		S []f.Public          `json:"s"`
		A *[2]f.Public        `json:"a"`
		M map[string]f.Public `json:"m"`
	}{P: p, S: s, A: a, M: vals}
}

type BoxRoot struct {
	P  *f.Box           `json:"p"`
	S  []f.Box          `json:"s"`
	A  *[2]f.Box        `json:"a"`
	M  map[string]f.Box `json:"m"`
	N  f.Nest           `json:"n"`
	V  f.Box            `json:"v"`
	E  f.Embed          `json:"e"`
	NP *f.Nest          `json:"np"`
	NS []f.Nest         `json:"ns"`
}

func freshBox(n int) f.Box {
	return f.Box{X: f.Count{N: n}}
}

func freshBoxPtr(n int) *f.Box {
	b := freshBox(n)
	return &b
}

func freshNest(i, a int) f.Nest {
	return f.Nest{I: f.Inner{C: f.Count{N: i}}, A: [1]f.Box{freshBox(a)}}
}

func freshNestPtr(i, a int) *f.Nest {
	n := freshNest(i, a)
	return &n
}

func boxTarget() BoxRoot {
	p := freshBoxPtr(1)
	s := []f.Box{freshBox(2), freshBox(3)}
	a := [2]f.Box{freshBox(4), freshBox(5)}
	abs := &a
	vals := map[string]f.Box{"k": freshBox(6)}
	n := freshNest(7, 8)
	v := freshBox(9)
	e := f.Embed{Box: freshBoxPtr(10)}
	np := freshNestPtr(11, 12)
	ns := []f.Nest{freshNest(13, 14)}
	return BoxRoot{P: p, S: s, A: abs, M: vals, N: n, V: v, E: e, NP: np, NS: ns}
}

func boxMirror() f.Mirror {
	p := freshBoxPtr(1)
	s := []f.Box{freshBox(2), freshBox(3)}
	a := [2]f.Box{freshBox(4), freshBox(5)}
	abs := &a
	vals := map[string]f.Box{"k": freshBox(6)}
	n := freshNest(7, 8)
	v := freshBox(9)
	e := f.Embed{Box: freshBoxPtr(10)}
	np := freshNestPtr(11, 12)
	ns := []f.Nest{freshNest(13, 14)}
	return f.Mirror{P: p, S: s, A: abs, M: vals, N: n, V: v, E: e, NP: np, NS: ns}
}

func checkBoxState(t BoxRoot, m f.Mirror) {
	tp, ta, tnp, teb := t.P, t.A, t.NP, t.E.Box
	mp, ma, mnp, meb := m.P, m.A, m.NP, m.E.Box
	if tp == nil || ta == nil || tnp == nil || teb == nil || mp == nil || ma == nil || mnp == nil || meb == nil {
		panic("FAIL box nil pointer input")
	}
	tv, tok := t.M["k"]
	mv, mok := m.M["k"]
	if !tok || !mok {
		panic("FAIL box missing map input")
	}
	check := func(ok bool, msg string) {
		if !ok {
			fmt.Println("FAIL box", msg)
			os.Exit(1)
		}
	}
	check(tp.X.N == 99 && mp.X.N == 99, "pointer box")
	check(t.S[0].X.N == 99 && t.S[1].X.N == 99 && m.S[0].X.N == 99 && m.S[1].X.N == 99, "slice boxes")
	check(ta[0].X.N == 99 && ta[1].X.N == 99 && ma[0].X.N == 99 && ma[1].X.N == 99, "pointer array boxes")
	check(teb.X.N == 99 && meb.X.N == 99, "embedded pointer box")
	check(tnp.I.C.N == 99 && tnp.A[0].X.N == 99 && mnp.I.C.N == 99 && mnp.A[0].X.N == 99, "nested pointer")
	check(t.NS[0].I.C.N == 99 && t.NS[0].A[0].X.N == 99 && m.NS[0].I.C.N == 99 && m.NS[0].A[0].X.N == 99, "nested slice")
	check(tv.X.N == 6 && mv.X.N == 6, "map value copy")
	check(t.N.I.C.N == 7 && t.N.A[0].X.N == 8 && m.N.I.C.N == 7 && m.N.A[0].X.N == 8, "nested value copies")
	check(t.V.X.N == 9 && m.V.X.N == 9, "value field copy")
}

func checkBoxParity(t BoxRoot, m f.Mirror) {
	got, gerr := json.Marshal(t)
	if gerr != nil {
		fmt.Println("FAIL box target", gerr)
		os.Exit(1)
	}
	want, werr := json.Marshal(m)
	if werr != nil {
		fmt.Println("FAIL box mirror", werr)
		os.Exit(1)
	}
	if string(got) != string(want) {
		fmt.Println("FAIL box parity got=" + string(got) + " want=" + string(want))
		os.Exit(1)
	}
	checkBoxState(t, m)
}

func main() {
	got, gerr := json.Marshal(targetRoot())
	if gerr != nil {
		fmt.Println("FAIL target", gerr)
		os.Exit(1)
	}
	want, werr := json.Marshal(mirrorRoot())
	if werr != nil {
		fmt.Println("FAIL mirror", werr)
		os.Exit(1)
	}
	if !strings.Contains(string(want), "ptr:") || !strings.Contains(string(want), "val:") {
		fmt.Println("FAIL oracle", string(want))
		os.Exit(1)
	}
	if string(got) != string(want) {
		fmt.Println("FAIL parity got=" + string(got) + " want=" + string(want))
		os.Exit(1)
	}
	checkBoxParity(boxTarget(), boxMirror())
	fmt.Println("parity ok")
}
